concept.anti_generic_signature: Wind-up and hand press share a causal cam/ring/eight-root linkage; three registered bell colours and genuine captive bead joints preserve the requested engineered jellyfish rather than a static themed ornament.
assumptions: Original text-derived mechanised jellyfish; no supplied image or exact species-replica claim.
The 104 × 104 × 118 mm allocation includes the authored flared static pose; exact delivered bounds are determined by final geometry reports.
Rubber E 1 MPa and G 0.7 MPa are illustrative engineering assumptions; supplier grease viscosity 46 Pa s is specified at 50 s^-1 and is not known constant at this toy shear rate.

Return-loop relaxed circumference 56 mm includes two hitches; 4 mm total relaxed hitch allowance gives 26 mm free legs and estimated 0.338 N rest/0.585 N pressed force. Routing and actual loaded mass require physical calibration.

The translating solids give a CAD-derived mass estimate of 18.6769 g at density 1.27 g/cm3 with fully dense solids, excluding rocking chains and consumables (design/moving-mass.json). The retained 22 g calculation assumption adds 3.3231 g relative to that estimate; physical mass, force and operating performance remain unmeasured.
Ideal viscous motor decay from 16 to 5 turns estimates 28.0 to 37.4 seconds over the defined grease-gap range before load/friction/stall effects; 30 seconds remains a physical target.

build_plan.exit_criteria: Integrated stand, positive anchor and stator torque paths, relocated columns, carrier press stop and exact print stances receive component gates and native visual review.
Positive shaft retention, bounded axial gap, key arrows, hook loading path and stator interfaces are represented and inspected; numeric rigid-part print checks pass without claiming physical runtime.
Tangent follower, relieved keeper, real clips, elastic passages, removable girth-hitch arms and four ribbon roots pass relevant component and static fit checks.
Eight genuine captive PIP modules retain specified gaps; roots and clipped tangent journals fit the common ring and fixed forks; component print checks and still-image inspection pass.
Three registered filament regions, locally reinforced shell, scalloped rim and seated bayonet interfaces pass final component inspection before the complete object is reviewed.

concept.interaction: Hold the foot and wind the underbell key clockwise viewed from below, no more than 16 turns from relaxed, then release. Press the seated bell to the physical 4 mm stop: the common inner ring descends and all eight tentacle roots flare and lift. Release to let the return loops raise it. After the motor stops, gently turn the key to the highest bell position for full manual stroke. Reverse the listed removable retainers, bayonets and threaded elastic attachments for service.

materials.consumables: natural-rubber motor and return loops; damping grease

novel_mechanisms.definition: A rotating tilted planar cam above a spherical-nose, elastic-return follower pushes the bell/yoke downward 4 mm. Hand pressing separates follower from cam; no backdrive clutch is needed.

A guided yoke and relieved keeper capture eight inward 7 mm horns in 3 mm-height tracks. Four millimetres of depression gives 34.8499-degree root rotation, 10.2857 mm outward anchor travel and 3.2282 mm lift.

A retained grease annulus between a keyed rotating cup and fixed stator resists rotation without an escapement. Primary radii 5.6 to 9.0 mm and axial gap 0.8 to 0.6 mm follow the retained 0.2 mm stack clearance.

Eight PIP modules each contain one rocker root, seven repeated beads and one terminal bead. Mushroom pins in slotted eyes have 0.4 mm radial clearance and remain distinct captive solids in the manufacturing layout.

concept.print_stance: Bell regions registered crown down; support upright; frame inverted; carrier, yoke, keeper, cup and washer flat; cam top down; shaft, clips, cross-key, return arms and ribbons on broad faces; complete PIP strands in their saved flat layout.
risks: Motion unverified under operator policy; no sweeps, animation or independent motion review.
Print-gap release, captive-joint articulation, elastic fatigue, clip life, grease compatibility, sound and timed operation have not been physically tested.
Frame axial seating is intentionally removable/gravity-seated; no positive axial carrier lock is claimed.
Rubber variability, hitch consumption and cam loads can cause weak return or early stall; the instructions require physical calibration and do not assert measured performance.
Static and print gate evidence belongs to the current root reports; this document does not turn pending checks into passes.
concept.signature_interaction: A seated pearl bell dips 4 mm while a visible pale-blue inner ring descends and all eight articulated tentacle roots lift and flare around four wider central ribbons.
concept.summary: A pearl jellyfish desk companion with a pressable bell, eight articulated bead tentacles and four ribbon arms. Its wind-up rubber drive is designed to repeat a slow swimming pulse.
concept.title: Pearl Pulse

cad_derived_translating_mass.basis: Exact source volumes treated as fully dense PETG; includes translating bell regions, slider, keeper, keeper pins/clips, return arms and ribbons; excludes rocking chains and consumables. Infill and actual material can change physical mass.
cad_derived_translating_mass.interpretation: The unchanged 22 g translating-load assumption is conservative relative to this CAD-derived 18.6769 g value; it is not a bound on all operating loads or proof of return force.

load_margin.limitation: Separate maxima produce a conservative bound; early stall remains possible and no loaded operating result is inferred.

return_force.uncertainty: A 0 to 8 mm hitch allowance changes rest force 0.20 to 0.50 N and pressed force 0.43 to 0.77 N; actual nonlinear rubber and routing need physical calibration.

runtime.excluded: Dry friction, cam/spring/gravity torque, band hysteresis/nonlinearity, grease rheology and stall; no measured 30-second claim.
runtime.formula: b=pi*mu*(Ro^4-Ri^4)/(2h); t=(b/kt)*ln(16/5); SI radii/gap converted to Nmm seconds

analytical_estimates.status: illustrative quasi-static algebra only; no motion sweep or physical proof

vault.responses: Motor fatigue: 16-turn instruction and serviceable real hooks, with burr/edge finishing required. Journal and retention: clear dry octagonal bearing, named thrust washer and positive cross-key. Stability: integrated 58 mm foot; physical handling unverified. Winding: actual underside arrows; number in instructions only. Reset: accessible key and removable bayonets/retainers. Traction loss is inapplicable. Sweep risk remains unverified under host motion policy. Minimum-wall rule remains required.
